all_query_records.reading_focus: Return or destroy Confidential Information upon termination, including copies and certification

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Agreement shall not grant Receiving Party any right to Confidential Information.
all_query_records.reason: No property rights granted by Agreement.
all_query_records.reading_focus: No property rights granted by Agreement, requires separate written agreement for any grant

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
all_query_records.reason: No mention of Agreement terms confidentiality.
all_query_records.reading_focus: No mention of Agreement terms confidentiality, no explicit prohibition on disclosure of negotiation

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Confidential Information shall only include technical information.
all_query_records.reason: Includes non-technical information like financial data.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Confidential Information includes non-technical data (financial, customer lists, etc.), not limited to technical info

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: All Confidential Information shall be expressly identified by the Disclosing Party.
all_query_records.reason: Defined as provided information, not requiring explicit identification.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Confidential Information defined as provided information, not requiring explicit identification by Disclosing Party

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Some obligations of Agreement may survive termination of Agreement.
all_query_records.reason: Confidentiality maintained for two years post-termination.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Confidentiality obligations survive termination for 2 years, including post-termination restrictions

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party may independently develop information similar to Confidential Information.
all_query_records.reason: Use restricted to business evaluation, no explicit prohibition on independent development.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Use restrictions for business evaluation, no explicit prohibition on independent development of similar info

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
all_query_records.reason: Mandates return or destruction, not retention.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Return/destroy obligation vs. post-termination confidentiality maintenance period

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Confidential Information may include verbally conveyed information.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Confidential Information includes oral and written information, not limited to written records

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not solicit some of Disclosing Party's representatives.
all_query_records.reading_focus: No solicitation provisions in Agreement, no restrictions on contacting representatives

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some third-parties (including consultants, agents and professional advisors).
all_query_records.reason: Sharing with employees/advisors allowed when necessary.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Sharing with employees/advisors only when necessary for disclosed purpose, Recipient liable for unauthorized disclosures

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party may create a copy of some Confidential Information in some circumstances.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Reproduction allowed for Agreement purpose, copies remain Provider's property with original notices

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party shall notify Disclosing Party in case Receiving Party is required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.
all_query_records.reason: No explicit requirement for legal process notification.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Court order disclosure permitted with prior notice, no explicit requirement for legal process notification

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party may acquire information similar to Confidential Information from a third party.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Exceptions for prior possession, third-party lawful disclosure, and public availability

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of Receiving Party's employees.
all_query_records.reason: Sharing with employees allowed when necessary.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Sharing with employees only when necessary for disclosed purpose, Recipient liable for unauthorized disclosures

all_query_records.original_hypothesis: Receiving Party shall not use any Confidential Information for any purpose other than the purposes stated in Agreement.
all_query_records.reason: Use restricted to evaluating business relationships.
all_query_records.reading_focus: Use restricted to evaluating/pursuing business relationship, no other purposes permitted
